title: asks.answer
description: Answers one ask. The first valid answer wins; an invalid one is bad_request, reason bad_answer, and leaves the ask open; an ask already ended is already_resolved (an evicted one included), an id never issued unknown_ask.

answer.description: An answer, each kind reading its own members and refusing any other kind's. permission: optionId, the exact id of an offered option (never a kind), or cancel. question: answers (each question's id to the option ids chosen) and, for a question with allowText, text (its id to a free-text answer, at most 4096 bytes, beside its picks or alone), or skip, or, on claude alone, cancel (the question withdrawn, which its tool takes as aborted; bad_answer on any other provider); a question with required set cannot be skipped and must have an option id; a single-choice question takes at most one option id; a question that asks nothing takes {}. plan: exactly one of accept and reject.
